clue.text: Domestic employee's mother conceals one attractive quality

indicators.note: to conceal is to hide something within, so the employee's word takes the numeral inside it

parts.note: a char is a cleaning woman; with the possessive it becomes CHAR'S
I is the Roman numeral one
ma is a familiar word for mother

explanation.surface: A cleaner's mother is hiding some appealing trait of hers.
explanation.walkthrough: A char is a British cleaning lady. 'conceals' puts I inside CHARS, ahead of MA.
explanation.definitionFit: Charisma is personal magnetism, a compelling charm that draws others in.

clue.text: Councillor drinks milky coffee, making loud noise

indicators.note: drinking takes something into oneself, so the councillor's abbreviation swallows the coffee

parts.note: a latte is coffee made with lots of steamed milk

explanation.surface: A local councillor slurps a latte and makes a racket.
explanation.definitionFit: A clatter is a rattling, banging din, the kind made by dropped crockery.

clue.text: Writer of stories regularly wavers before work

indicators.note: one piece placed before another sets the order of the two parts
taking letters at regular intervals means every other letter of wavers

parts.note: op, short for opus, is a musical work

explanation.surface: A storyteller keeps hesitating before starting a piece of work.
explanation.definitionFit: Aesop is the ancient Greek teller of fables such as the tortoise and the hare.

clue.text: Aware of what's going on, as artist's models will be?

definitions.meaning: informed, kept up to date about events
models posing for a painter literally appear within the painted image

explanation.surface: Someone well informed, compared with the people who sit for painters.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means being kept informed; literally, a sitter appears inside the painting.

clue.text: Whisky available on a European island

parts.note: a malt is a malt whisky

explanation.surface: A place in Europe where whisky can be had.
explanation.definitionFit: Malta is an island nation in the Mediterranean, a member of the European Union.

clue.text: A politician joining Conservative faction

indicators.note: here one piece joins up with the next, sitting side by side in the order given

parts.note: MP stands for Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: A member of Parliament crossing over to the Tory side of a split.
explanation.definitionFit: A camp is a group sharing a view within a larger body, a synonym for a faction.

clue.text: Worker consumes citrus fruit for nourishment

indicators.note: consuming takes food inside, so the worker's letters wrap round the fruit

parts.note: the worker ant is a crossword staple
a lime is a small green citrus fruit

explanation.surface: An employee eats a citrus fruit to keep going.
explanation.definitionFit: Aliment is a formal word for food, whatever sustains or feeds the body.

clue.text: Reporters gripped by depression

indicators.note: something gripped by a word is held within its letters

explanation.surface: Journalists caught in a low mood, or in a dip in the economy.
explanation.definitionFit: The press is the collective name for journalists and newspapers.

clue.text: Gosh, here's a way to start a fire

definitions.meaning: a mild British exclamation of surprise, like 'blimey'

definitions.text: here's a way to start a fire
definitions.meaning: rubbing a match on a box produces a flame

explanation.surface: An exclamation of surprise followed by tips on lighting a fire.
explanation.walkthrough: The exclamation is old-fashioned Cockney British slang for surprise or exasperation.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is both a dated cry of astonishment and literally lighting a match.

clue.text: Something worth having, like television?

parts.note: as means like, in the same way as
a television is a TV set

explanation.surface: Is television something valuable to own?
explanation.definitionFit: An asset is a useful or valuable thing, quality or possession.

clue.text: Ornamental framework the French placed round upper room

indicators.note: the article is put around the room, enclosing it

parts.note: le is French for the
an attic is a room at the top of a house

explanation.surface: French decorative trellis is fitted around a loft room.
explanation.definitionFit: A lattice is a criss-cross grid of strips, often decorative, as on a window or trellis.

clue.text: Best plaything for a child?

definitions.meaning: a spinning toy that whirls on its point

explanation.surface: Asking what the finest toy for a youngster is.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means foremost, and is also the spinning toy children play with.

clue.text: They test tool rejected by underground workers

indicators.note: rejected means sent back, so the tool's name is read backwards

parts.note: an axe is a chopping tool
miners work underground in pits

explanation.surface: Pit workers turn down a tool after trying it out.
explanation.definitionFit: Examiners are people who set and mark tests, checking candidates' knowledge.

clue.text: Jewish teacher has time to talk

parts.note: a rabbi is a Jewish religious teacher

explanation.surface: A rabbi finds a moment to chat.
explanation.walkthrough: In British slang, to rabbit (on) is to chatter at length; it comes from rhyming slang 'rabbit and pork' for talk.
explanation.definitionFit: British slang for chattering away, often tediously and at length.

clue.text: Carried hot grub out

indicators.note: out suggests the letters are thrown out of order and rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone took hot food outside.
explanation.definitionFit: Past tense of bring, meaning conveyed or carried along.

clue.text: Dog hidden by swirling cigarette smoke

indicators.note: smoke swirling turns around, so the hidden letters are read backwards
the run of letters lies concealed within the two words

explanation.surface: A dog lost from view in a cloud of tobacco smoke.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hidden by' picks RETTES out of cigaRETTE Smoke, and 'swirling' reads it backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: A setter is a breed of gun dog, such as the Irish or English variety.

clue.text: Biker with yen for a garden

parts.note: Rockers were 1960s British motorcycle gang members, rivals of the Mods
Y is the abbreviation for the Japanese currency, the yen

explanation.surface: A motorcyclist with a longing for a garden.
explanation.walkthrough: 'yen' looks like a longing; it is the currency.
explanation.definitionFit: A rockery is a kind of garden built from stones with plants between them.

clue.text: Deficit, the consequence of a lengthy summer?

definitions.meaning: an amount by which something falls short

definitions.text: the consequence of a lengthy summer
definitions.meaning: a long summer leaves only a brief autumn, which Americans call fall

explanation.surface: A shortage, blamed on a summer that dragged on.
explanation.definitionFit: A shortfall is a deficit; read literally, it is a brief autumn.

clue.text: Sea creature's quiet, approaching vessel

indicators.note: one piece coming up to the next puts it in front

parts.note: sh is a call for quiet
an ark is a boat, as in Noah's

explanation.surface: A sea creature silently closing in on a boat.
explanation.definitionFit: A shark is a predatory fish of the oceans, an example of a sea creature.

clue.text: Knowing fighting takes place in A & E

indicators.note: the fighting happens inside, so its word sits within the other letters

parts.note: the letters are A and E as written, from Accident and Emergency
war is fighting between nations

explanation.surface: A brawl breaks out in the hospital casualty department.
explanation.walkthrough: A & E (Accident and Emergency) is a British hospital's emergency department.
explanation.definitionFit: Being aware means knowing about something, conscious of it.

clue.text: Medic does operations carefully for starters

indicators.note: the starters of the words are their first letters

explanation.surface: A doctor works carefully in surgery.
explanation.definitionFit: Doc is an informal word for a doctor.

clue.text: Herd of livestock wander beyond far end of field

indicators.note: wandering beyond something comes after it, so this piece follows
the far end of a word is its last letter

parts.note: to rove is to wander

explanation.surface: Cattle roam past the far side of a field.
explanation.definitionFit: A drove is a herd of animals being driven along together.

clue.text: Amazingly large island to west of a Mediterranean country

indicators.note: in an across entry west is the left, so this piece precedes the next
something amazingly altered is twisted out of shape, so the letters are reshuffled

explanation.surface: A big island lies west of a Mediterranean nation.
explanation.definitionFit: Algeria is a North African nation with a long coastline on the Mediterranean.

clue.text: Feel half-grotty before gym lesson

indicators.note: one piece placed before another sets the order of the two parts
half of a six-letter word is its first three letters

parts.note: PE is physical education, the school gym lesson

explanation.surface: Feeling a bit rough before PE class.
explanation.walkthrough: Grotty is British slang for unpleasant or unwell.
explanation.definitionFit: To grope is to feel about blindly with the hands.

clue.text: Bird: it's spotted within Kildare's borders

indicators.note: seen inside, so these letters sit between the others
the borders of a word are its first and last letters

explanation.surface: A bird sighted at the edge of the Irish county Kildare.
explanation.definitionFit: A kite is a bird of prey with a forked tail, such as the red kite.

clue.text: Like birds, they fare badly

indicators.note: something done badly is botched or jumbled, so the letters of the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: Some people are not getting on well at all.
explanation.definitionFit: Feathery means covered with or resembling plumage, as birds are.
